approaches.title: Threshold arithmetic count
approaches.summary: Counts valid comma-containing numbers by returning zero below 1000 and otherwise computing n minus 999. The second revision preserves this arithmetic strategy with a branchless saturating subtraction.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses a conditional threshold check: returns 0 for n below 1000, otherwise returns n - 999.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3870: make branchlesss using cpu intrinsics
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the conditional with unsigned saturating subtraction by 999, preserving the same threshold arithmetic branchlessly.
